---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or improvement for mcp-geo
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description. Why is this useful for the typical mcp-geo user (someone running an LLM agent over a geospatial workflow)?

**Proposed solution**
What the new tool / change should look like. Include the tool name, parameters, and expected output shape.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, example agent prompts that would benefit, links to upstream services or libraries, etc.
